text:
hana: Quick flag from the quant8 bring-up on qx2b: we're seeing degraded summary faithfulness for non-English long-docs (fr,de,es) when context >800 tokens. Small sample but consistent.
ravi: ouch. Which eval set? our multilingual golden has only ~30 long docs per language.
hana: exactly. The current longctx multilingual golden is tiny; most coverage is short snippets.
mika: any repro examples?
hana: pasted anonymized French case below (trimmed):
```
> prompt: long french news article (~1.1k tokens)
expected: concise factual summary (3 bullets with source sentences)
quant8 output: invents an event date + wrong person attribution
```
hana: float16 baseline is fine for same prompt.
research-bot: quick stat dump: on multilingual-long (n=120)
float16: rouge-l 0.42, hallucination-rate 3.1%
quant8:   rouge-l 0.36, hallucination-rate 10.8%
mika: that's material for SLAs. We should expand golden and do targeted A/B before wider rollout.
ravi: agree. Proposal: create +150 long multilingual docs (50 per language), focus on news + legal + tech longforms; include golden references.
hana: add tags per sample: language, domain (news/legal/tech), severity-check (0-3). We'll mark severity 3 as hallucinated facts.
labeler-bot: Creating batch LBL-5022 (150 samples). ETA 72 hours, expedited 36h if we assign 3x reviewers.
ops-bot: infra action item: route requests with (input_tokens>800 && lang!=en) to model:qx2b_f16_v1 for canary. Creating INFRA-1310.
ops-bot: INFRA-1310 created. Canary deployment ETA ~90m.
mika: also add an alert: if multilingual-long hallucination-rate >7% over 30m -> page ENG-ML. ops-bot: AR-910 created.
ravi: research note: quant8 calibration may be language-sensitive due to disparate token distributions. I'll run per-layer symmetric vs asymmetric quant experiments and a vocab-adaptive calibration. Expect initial results in 48h.
hana: while that runs, let's add instrumented attention diffs for 20 repros and capture token alignments (PII redacted). Need extra debug GPUs?
research-bot: allocated 2 debug GPUs in lab-3 for 24h window.
labeler-bot: Instructions for labelers (brief):
- For each sample, run both models (quant8 & f16) and paste outputs.
- Provide a 0-3 severity.
- If severity>=2, annotate the specific hallucinated claims or wrong attributions.
- For translations, include original snippet+translation of the hallucinated sentence.
- Mark any sensitive text as redacted.

mika: good. Also request that labelers include the top-3 source spans that support the reference summary. Helps pinpoint missing attention hops.
hana: who wants to own the eval job and dashboards? I'll pair with @ravi on that.
ravi: I'll take it. I'll wire up a diff dashboard that breaks down by language/domain and severity.
mika: timeline: create batch now, canary routing in 90m, experiments + label pass 48-72h, decision to proceed/rollback after label analysis.
hana: small mitigation: gate quant8 on lang==en or input_tokens<=800 for now. ops-bot: quick routing rule applied to canary only.
research-bot: scheduling follow-up sync in 3 days to review labeler results and per-layer quant metrics.
ravi: thumbs up. Thanks team.
labeler-bot: LBL-5022 assigned to team 'golden-ops-multilang', sprint 'urgent'.
ops-bot: INFRA-1310 rolled to canary; routing verified in canary infra.
hana: I'll post the first instrumented attention diffs when ready (target ~24h).
mika: thanks :heart:
